scripts.copy-bootstrap: mkdir -p assets/css assets/js && cp node_modules/bootstrap/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css assets/css/ && cp node_modules/bootstrap/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js assets/js/
scripts.copy-fontawesome: mkdir -p assets/fontawesome/css assets/fontawesome/webfonts && cp node_modules/@fortawesome/fontawesome-free/css/all.min.css assets/fontawesome/css/ && cp -R node_modules/@fortawesome/fontawesome-free/webfonts/. assets/fontawesome/webfonts/
scripts.copy-assets: npm run copy-bootstrap && npm run copy-fontawesome
scripts.start: npm run copy-assets && bundle exec jekyll serve
